description.describe_ch: 本課程以教授電聲量測理論為基礎，搭配目前電聲產業必備的SoundCheck電聲量測系統操作為輔，協助修課學生逐步完成電聲產品量測知識的養成與技術之培養。課程規劃上則以常見的電聲產品量測項目為核心，包含揚聲器單體(系統)與麥克風單體(系統)之頻率響應、諧波失真、THD、阻抗曲線、指向性、靈敏度等，從實際操作中導入訊號處理之基本觀念與計算，以及學習如何從專業的角度與術語初評產品的優劣，乃至於提出可能的解決方案
description.describe_eh: This course is based on the teaching of ElectroAcoustic measurement theory, supplemented by the practical operations of SoundCheck system, to assist students to gradually complete the development of electro-acoustic measurement knowledge and technology. The curriculum planning focuses on common electroacoustic product measurement items, including the SPL, HD, THD, IMD, impedance curve, directivity, sensitivity, etc.

targets.describe_ch: 本課程提供研究生未來欲從事聲學量測相關研究主題之基本素養、知識。
targets.describe_en: Provide students the basic knowledge of related research topic in Electro-acoustics.

targets.describe_ch: 指導學生瞭解電聲量測之相關理論背景知識、發展趨勢、以及認識國際電聲量測法規。
targets.describe_en: Students are enable to realize the theoretical knowledge, trend of development, and international standard in electro-acousitcs field.

targets.describe_ch: 指導學生熟悉電聲量測軟硬體設備，以及其操作，
targets.describe_en: Students are enable to be familiar with the function of hardware and software, and all the operations in the measurements.

targets.describe_ch: 指導能獨自實驗並將得到之數據加以分析解釋。
targets.describe_en: Students are enable to finish the experiment by themselves, also to analyze the data obtained.
